tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the published catalog by artist, title, label, catalog number or barcode. In-stock records only unless in_stock_only is false.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one record by slug: pressing, sleeve and media condition, tracks, price, stock, shipping per country.

tools.name: shipping_quote
tools.description: What shipping an order of a given subtotal costs to a country. Free from the free-shipping threshold.

tools.name: cart_link
tools.description: A URL that fills the human's cart on 72records.be with these records. Give it to the human; they check out there. Sold records are skipped when they open it.
